newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to decrease margins on BFP Milk contracts.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to decrease margins on BFP Milk contracts.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange (CSCE) said Monday it will decrease margins on the July 1997 and August 1997 BFP Milk contracts by $200 to $300, including no spot charge, effective July 15.
The margin required on all other BFP Milk contracts will also be decreased by $200 to $300, the exchange said in a statement.

As a result, CSCE said the inter-commodity straddle rate for Milk/BFP Milk will decrease by $40 to $160, while BFP Milk/Chedder Cheese will be lowered by $60 to $180 and BFP Milk/Nonfat Dry Milk-Butter will decrease by $300 to $850.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said.
